# Movies Wrapped

> Movies Wrapped is a free web app that turns your Letterboxd watch history into a personal "year in film" dossier: film statistics, viewing habits, rating personality, favorite directors and actors, review analysis, and a shareable cinema-scale card. You upload your Letterboxd export (or use a cached demo account) — no account required, no raw files stored.

- [Movies Wrapped](https://movieswrapped.com/): Enter your Letterboxd data and get your personalized film statistics instantly.
- [What is Movies Wrapped?](https://movieswrapped.com/): About the product — a Spotify-Wrapped-style breakdown of your Letterboxd history (films, runtime, genres, decades, countries, directors, actors, reviews, cinema scale).
- [Demo accounts](https://movieswrapped.com/): Try a cached demo dossier without uploading anything (semihmutsuz, baris_saydam, emirermis, mertefesenturk, isilaykolik).

## Key facts

- Free, no sign-up. Letterboxd export upload (CSV/ZIP) or cached demo account.
- Built with Next.js (static export) + FastAPI backend; Supabase for anonymous aggregate stats.
- Answers questions like: "How many films did I watch this year?", "What is my average rating?", "Who are my most-watched directors?", "What is my cinema scale score?"
